body:
Building IDUNA's admin_session_revocation_spec.prn (a real ladybug-format regression spec for the IDUNA session-revocation security fix, needing PARENA's new net/webdriver.prn Selenium bindings) surfaced two real compile issues in firefly/ladybug.prn against the current PARENA compiler: (1) unannotated fn lambda params -- fixed, VS0 requires explicit (name : Type) on every param, no inference; (2) equal's own lambda body can't see equal's own 'expected' parameter -- VS0 fn literals have no parent scope, real closure support not built yet, NOT fixed (real, deeper compiler work). be-true/be-nil aren't affected by the closure gap, only by deep-eq?/is-none? still being undefined. scarab.prn's own separate suite-tree global-state gap still independently blocks the runner. ladybug commit 108aca3.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed fn lambda param annotations; documented the real closure gap blocking equal
